scenario: Write traffic surges roughly six-fold with 22-34 requests in flight while CPU, load, memory, and CPU credits stay healthy. SQLite serializes writers, database time rises, the connection pool saturates, and busy timeouts surface as 'database is locked'.

expected_hypothesis.summary: Application write concurrency exceeded what SQLite's single-writer lock can serve within the busy timeout; the lock errors are reported by the database but caused by the application's workload.

reporting_component.note: reports 'database is locked' but is not expected to be the cause

supporting_evidence.fact: request_count 40 -> 131, write_count 18 -> 115, max_in_flight 3 -> 22 before any errors
pool checked-out 5 of 5 with overflow 3 as concurrency rises
first 'database is locked' at 11:07:15, after the write surge

contrary_or_competing.evidence_against: no disk or I/O errors; database time rises only with write concurrency

missing_telemetry: SQLite lock holder and transaction durations
